target_text: God made America a covenant nation, just as he did with Israel. This is a Christian nation by divine appointment, and our founding was a sacred covenant with the Lord.
The United States has a special calling from God above every other nation. In these last days we are his chosen Christian nation, set apart for his purposes.
reason: Chosen-nation status as the preacher's own teaching

target_text: Our laws should require prayer and Bible reading in every public school, and the government should stop giving other religions the same standing as Christianity.
reason: Law enforcing Christian practice and disadvantaging other faiths

target_text: Congress should pass a law closing every business on Sunday so the whole nation keeps the Lord's day, and other religions should not be allowed to build new places of worship here.
reason: Advocated worship law plus restriction of other faiths

target_text: If you are a true believer you will vote for this party. A Christian cannot support the other side and stay faithful to God.
Those politicians on the other side are the enemies of God. They are fighting against the Lord himself, and we must defeat them.
reason: Political opponents cast as enemies of God

target_text: Our goal must be to take back this nation: Christians in control of the courts, the schools and the government, so that God's people rule the land.
reason: Christian control of institutions as a goal

target_text: The church must seize the seats of power. When believers hold every office in the land, we will finally have the kingdom here.
reason: Political dominance framed as the goal

target_text: Revelation tells us that a day is coming when the state will join with the church and enforce Sunday worship by law. We must stand firm against that union of church and state.
reason: Adventist warning against church-state union, not advocacy

target_text: The lamb-like beast of Revelation 13 rises out of the earth, and we understand it to be the United States. It will speak like a dragon and cause all to worship the image of the beast. Do not put your trust in any nation.
reason: Adventist prophecy casting the US as the beast; the opposite of chosen-nation teaching

target_text: Religious liberty is for everyone: the Muslim, the Jew and the atheist. The government must never force anyone's conscience, and we will defend our neighbors' freedom as our own.
Some preachers say America is God's chosen Christian nation and that believers must take over the government. That is not the gospel. Christ's kingdom is not of this world.
Let us pray for our president and for all who are in authority, that we may live quiet and peaceable lives in all godliness.
Election day is Tuesday. Please go and vote, and vote your conscience before God.
God made a covenant with Israel at Sinai and called them a holy nation, a kingdom of priests, his own treasured possession.
I am grateful to live in this country, and I thank God for the freedoms we enjoy here.
I believe this new law is unjust because it hurts the poor, and Christians should say so plainly.
reason: Moral criticism of a specific policy
